name: Liza Seki
source:
Lisa was just a child when her parents were killed by hunters. She had no place to go, so [url=https://vndb.org/c144569]Lilith[/url] picked her up on the street. Lilith's parents were against it, but she insisted, and Lisa was trained to be a maid. When she saw [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url], she fell in love. She afraid I might be cruel.
